title: Audit and verify the complete focused stats feature
description: Perform the final integration audit across aggregation, parsing, rendering, JSON, help, README, and changelog. Confirm focused queries avoid handoffs, provider and storage interfaces remain unchanged, existing stats output remains compatible, time boundaries are consistently half-open, the clock is captured once, custom status order is preserved, unset models remain explicit, and charts never leak into JSON. Inspect parallel-task overlap and make only narrow corrective changes. Run gofmt validation, go test ./..., go vet ./..., git diff --check, and the repository's commit verification script. Record exact commands and outcomes in the completion comment; do not redesign the accepted command or JSON contracts.

comments.message: Started final integration audit: reviewing current focused-stats changes, public contracts, parallel-task overlap, and full verification requirements.
